claim.statement: At tag v1.18.15, OpenCode's default agent definitions make Build the default primary agent; make Plan a primary agent that denies edit except for named OpenCode plan paths and denies the general subagent; and define General and Explore as subagents with distinct tool permissions. The tagged Plan definition does not add a Plan-specific bash restriction.
